Weekly Signal — August 31–September 6, 2026

0 new archive items, 3 active builds, and a clean-room rebuild of Agent Workflow System.

New in the archive

No articles were published during this completed week.

Active builds

  • rapp-map — Map of the RAPP ecosystem — which repo houses which part of the spec (canonical homes for the kited neighborhood, runtime, registry, agents, platform, social).
  • rapp-1 — RAPP/1 — the wire that carries agents. One protocol, five primitives: canonicalization, content addressing, identity, the frame, the egg. Spec + reference implementation + conformance suite + book.
  • rapp-spine — 🦴 Crawl the spine — a situational router over the full RAPP protocol stack. Situation -> layer -> protocol, collisions named.

Rediscovered

Autonomy Budget: $200/day, Circuit Breakers, and the Virtue of Hard Caps — An autonomous AI system burns tokens. Without a cap, it burns your savings. Here's the daily-budget + circuit-breaker pattern that keeps a 24/7 multi-agent system's LLM spend predictable.

Lost App → clean-room lesson

Agent Workflow System: A browser-based agent workflow workshop rebuilt as a safe local simulator that treats imported code only as data.

Open the rebuild lesson · Run the local demo

RAPP Vision brief

This abandoned browser app could compose an entire agent workflow without running a single real agent.

How to design a visual agent workflow editor without accidentally building a remote-code execution engine.

Short: Three workflow nodes, zero live agents, one complete local simulation.
